title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
DATA QUALITY ANALYST

LONDON/HYBRID

UP TO £80,000

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing data function within a globally recognised professional services organisation undergoing significant data transformation. You'll play a key role in improving data quality, shaping data management processes, and working closely with business stakeholders to ensure trusted, reliable data supports decision-making across the organisation.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Data Quality Analyst will:

  • Partner with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Technology teams to identify and address data quality challenges
  • Conduct data profiling, analysis, and gap assessments to uncover opportunities for improvement
  • Investigate root causes of data issues and coordinating remediation activities
  • Design and maintaining data quality reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and performance metrics
  • Support data quality monitoring, testing, and ongoing governance activities
  • Work closely with data governance colleagues to improve data ownership, lineage, and control frameworks
  • Communicate the impact of data initiatives to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Support transformation programmes to ensure data requirements and quality standards are embedded throughout delivery

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

The ideal candidate will have the following kills and experience:

  • Strong commercial experience in data quality, data management, data governance, or related data disciplines
  • Experience engaging with business stakeholders to define requirements and drive data improvement initiatives
  • SQL skills for data analysis, profiling, and issue investigation
  • Experience creating reports, dashboards, and communicating insights to a range of audiences
  • Understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and validity
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts such as data lineage, metadata, ownership, and controls
  • Experience working within professional services, consulting, financial services, legal, healthcare, or similarly regulated environments
  • Exposure to SAP, SAP HANA, Databricks, or enterprise data transformation programmes would be advantageous
  • A structured, detail-oriented approach with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
